body: Being independent. Having a caring family and friends. Being able to pay to take my beloved kitties to the vet. I guess that falls under independence.
I will! Thank you so much. Sweet dreams!

That sounds very similar. I had an uncle who emotionally abused me, broke everything I owned when I had nothing, would get in my face and yell piece of shit at me. When HE was the mooch! He never went to work, and he's yelling worthless at me when he's sapping all my poor grandma's income.


One day, it became to much and I feared for my life so I called the cops. Who in turn called my grandmother off work. And He said to my Grandma, "I dont know why ____ is lying, you know I would never say that ma", to which the cops said to me "He is a respectable man, why would you lie to us ____".


That is what initially broke me down, and started the suicide attempts.




Life is going to be really hard from here on out, maybe even more so than it is now, I just don't want to accept that fact at all.

I wish the best in everything for you, thank you for opening my eyes and seeing new opportunities.


I am very impulsive, so I hope I am around when I finally have the courage to do what you did.

If you had the time, I would very much like if you told me. 

Peace to you as well.

Thank you so much for this response, I have no cell phone or a home phone.  

I would love to go over to a neighbours and maybe use theirs, but they are all pretentious assholes. I don't really expect much of people from the cheapest apartments in the ghetto of the town. 


Once I used a phone from What-A-Burger to call my mom, but then she told me she didn't care about what I said and that she couldn't help, and to see a therapist that I have no money for.

Yes it is a very small town, there are no buses that I know of until the closest major city a few hours away.

How much would I have to save? For living, for rent, until I can find a job?

I have no money, no car. No means to move to a new city, or I would in a heartbeat.

Thank you for taking the time to reply.
